narrative_purpose: The chapter's full-bleed atmospheric background — a vast, immersive macro vista the reader's text floats over, setting the mood for the whole post.
subject: An immense panoramic vista of Pandora's floating mountains seen from very far away and high up — dozens of grey rock islands of many sizes suspended across an enormous sky, dwindling into deep atmospheric haze toward the horizon. No single subject dominates; the scale is planetary and overwhelming.
scene: Deep night under a faint bioluminescent glow. Thick layered mist and cloud banks roll between the distant floating masses. The whole scene is dim and low-contrast, mostly dark, so overlaid text stays readable — light is sparse and atmospheric, not a bright focal burst.
camera: Ultra-wide establishing panorama, extreme depth, very high vantage looking out and slightly down across the whole archipelago to a distant hazy horizon.
light: Very low-key moonless night lighting; faint cool glow rising from mist far below and from scattered bioluminescent patches; no strong highlights, deliberately underexposed and moody.
palette: Predominantly deep void blue and near-black, with restrained cyan and teal glows in the mist; almost no warm tones; overall dark and macro.
style: Cinematic matte-painting establishing shot, vast atmospheric depth, painterly photoreal.
detail_level: Soft and atmospheric throughout — no crisp foreground subject; detail dissolves into haze so the image reads as ambient backdrop, not a figure to study.
composition: Full-bleed, horizon low, immense empty sky filling most of the frame; visual weight spread evenly with no bright center, leaving the upper-middle calm and dark for text overlay.
consistency_notes: Grey rock and cyan-teal mist matching the chapter's other floating-mountain scenes, but darker, wider, and more distant — a macro mood backdrop, not a close hero.
negative_prompt: no text, no logos, no people, no bright hotspot, no high contrast, no sharp foreground, no warm daylight, no oversaturation, no busy detail
